exam_scheme.note: Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) is conducted annually by the State OJEE Committee under the Skill Development and Technical Education Department, Government of Odisha, for admission into undergraduate and postgraduate professional courses (B.Pharm, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, M.Pharm, M.Arch, M.Plan, Integrated MBA, Lateral Entry B.Tech/B.Pharm, and Basic B.Sc Nursing) across government and private colleges and universities in Odisha. First Year B.Tech admissions are primarily based on JEE (Main) ranks through centralized OJEE web counselling, supplemented by 2nd/Special OJEE for unfilled vacancies. All tests are conducted in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. Under the standard marking scheme, each correct answer fetches 4 marks (+4), 1 mark is deducted for each incorrect answer (-1), and no marks are awarded or deducted for unattempted questions.
